Macrosomia refers to a very large body size. It is often used to describe an oversized fetus. Information The most common cause of macrosomia is diabetes in the mother. Macrosomia can lead to injury during birth and a greater chance of a cesarean delivery (C-section). Images Macrosomia References Blickstein I, Perlman S, Hazon Y, Shinwell ES.
